title: 비가 기억을 비추는 역
creative_thesis: 헤어진 사람을 잊으려는 여자가 마지막 열차역에서 기억을 피하지 않고 받아들이는 이야기.

world_bible.premise: 비가 내리는 동안 유리 표면에는 장소가 기억한 과거가 잠깐 비친다.
world_bible.emotional_thesis: 이별을 지우는 것이 아니라 견딜 수 있는 기억으로 바꾸는 과정.
reality_rules: 기억은 오직 젖은 유리나 얕은 물 표면에만 나타난다.
인물은 기억 속 자신과 직접 접촉할 수 없다.
world_bible.time_period: contemporary, timeless small Japanese coastal town
weather_rules: rain begins lightly and peaks before final chorus

characters.name: Mio
characters.identity_anchor: Japanese woman in her late 20s, calm face, shoulder-length dark hair
wardrobe_locks: same cream coat throughout station sequence

locations.name: Coastal station waiting room
locations.architectural_grammar: old local station, painted steel window frames, worn wood bench, large rain-streaked window
lighting_rules: warm tungsten interior against cool rainy exterior

story_beats.dramatic_question: 왜 그녀는 마지막 역에 혼자 와 있는가?
story_beats.change: 회피 상태에서 기억의 첫 흔적을 본다.
story_beats.visual_event: 빗물 흐르는 창에 과거의 두 사람이 희미하게 겹친다.

story_beats.dramatic_question: 기억을 붙잡는 것과 받아들이는 것은 같은가?
story_beats.change: 표를 버리지 않고 빈 의자 위에 두고 떠난다.
story_beats.visual_event: 문이 닫힌 뒤 빗물 속 반사만 남는다.

shots.narrative_function: Introduce the lonely world and her emotional distance
shots.subject: Mio sits alone on the bench, seen in soft three-quarter profile
shots.action: she remains still while only her eyes drift toward the rain-streaked window
shots.environment: old coastal station waiting room during gentle rain
shots.composition: medium-wide, Mio on right third, empty seat and window on left
shots.lighting: warm tungsten interior balanced against cool overcast window light
continuity_in: red ticket held in right hand

shots.narrative_function: Turn the recurring ticket from prop into emotional decision
shots.subject: Mio's right hand holding the muted red paper ticket beside the wet window
shots.action: her fingers loosen as if to drop it, then gently close again
shots.environment: same station window, rain trails moving down the glass
shots.composition: close-up of hand and ticket; her face only as soft reflection

camera.movement: locked camera with tiny breathing drift

shots.lighting: cool window light on hand, warm reflection from station interior

shots.narrative_function: Pay off the motif through acceptance rather than destruction
shots.subject: the empty opposite seat after Mio stands to leave
shots.action: she places the red ticket on the seat and exits frame; rain reflection settles
shots.environment: same waiting room, rain easing outside
shots.composition: medium shot centered on the empty seat, doorway in deep background

camera.movement: camera remains still after she exits

shots.lighting: warm interior remains, exterior becomes slightly brighter as rain eases
